# Remote Control Agent v0.1.38

This immutable three-platform candidate completes the narrow source reliability follow-up for [Spec #539](https://github.com/lirtual/mcp-workers/issues/539). Public MCP parameters and OS account permissions remain unchanged.

- A normalized Agent-local mutation queue key prevents trivial `/./` path spelling differences from bypassing same-path ordering.
- `replace_text` now compares the original opened file identity (when reliably available) and contents before its best-effort in-place edit. It still does **not** provide cross-process CAS or eliminate external TOCTOU races.
- Eligible Linux/ext **new-file creation** retains restricted temporary staging and exclusive publish. Existing files, symlinks, hardlinks and Windows paths deliberately preserve legacy in-place overwrite and its possible partial-write risk. `append` is unchanged.
- Durable SQLite operation receipts, stable `operation_id`, uncertain outcomes and no-blind-replay remain intact.
- A minimal native Windows CI fixture correction retains positive QUIC traffic and HTTP 403 assertions while reducing startup and DOM timing sensitivity. No browser runtime security rule was loosened.

**Source commit:** `9536205d8aeeea3b551fa24c608c954ab8d2ad0f`  
**Three-platform verified candidate:** https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/actions/runs/41050500073 (Success: Linux x64, Linux ARM64, Windows x64)  
**Source corrections:** https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/pull/73  
**Release-gate test correction:** https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/pull/74  
**Rollback baseline:** prior immutable v0.1.37. Rollback must preserve paired device identities and receipts.

Independent security review for earlier PR #71 was **Waived by Owner**, not independently performed. Release publication alone is not proof of Worker deployment or installed-device E2E. Verify the exact published artifacts, update the Worker installer pins through its existing release process, and perform separately authorized real-device verification before closing #539.
